# Two parties agree on terms. We propose them; the customer signs (in person
# above HKD 1,000,000) before the start date; we countersign, and the terms
# are effective until we close them with the customer's consent. Amendments
# need the customer's consent too, and only while the terms are proposed.
contract Agreement
parties we, customer

record Terms
  terms text
  amount HKD
  starts date

can amend by we with new_amount HKD, new_start date
  requires proposed
  requires consent of customer
  requires new_amount > HKD 0
  if new_amount > amount * 150%
    reject "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  otherwise
    amount = new_amount
  starts = new_start
can sign by customer
  over 1_000_000 requires in person
  requires now < starts
  proposed -> signed
can countersign by we
  signed -> effective
can close by we
  requires consent of customer
  effective -> closed

test "signed in person, countersigned, and closed"
  we create at 2026-10-14 with terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", amount = HKD 1_500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  we amend with new_amount = HKD 2_000_000, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> proposed
  customer sign -> refused "bo:in-person sign"
  customer sign in person -> signed
  we amend with new_amount = HKD 1, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> refused "bo:requires amend 1"
  we countersign -> effective
  we close at 2027-06-30 -> closed
  we close -> refused

test "what one party cannot do alone"
  we create with terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", amount = HKD 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  we amend with new_amount = HKD 600_000, new_start = 2027-01-01 -> consent of customer
  we amend with new_amount = HKD 900_000, new_start = 2027-01-01
  -> refused "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  we sign -> consent of customer
  customer countersign -> refused "bo:state countersign"
  customer sign by AI agent -> signed
  customer countersign -> consent of we
  we close -> refused "bo:state close"

test "too late to sign"
  we create with terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", amount = HKD 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  customer sign at 2027-01-02 -> refused "bo:requires sign 2"

# 雙方就條款達成協議。本公司提出條款；客戶於開始日期前簽署（金額超過港元
# 1,000,000 須親身確認）；本公司加簽後條款生效，直至本公司經客戶同意終結。
# 修訂亦須經客戶同意，且只限於條款仍屬已提議期間。
合約 Agreement
訂約方 本公司, 客戶

紀錄 Terms
  terms 文字
  金額 港元
  starts 日期

可 amend 由 本公司 連同 new_amount 港元, new_start 日期
  須 已提議
  須 經 客戶 同意
  須 new_amount > 港元 0
  如 new_amount > 金額 * 150%
    拒絕 "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  否則
    金額 = new_amount
  starts = new_start
可 sign 由 客戶
  超過 1_000_000 須親身確認
  須 現時 < starts
  已提議 -> signed
可 countersign 由 本公司
  signed -> effective
可 close 由 本公司
  須 經 客戶 同意
  effective -> closed

測試 "signed in person, countersigned, and closed"
  本公司 建立 時間 2026-10-14 連同 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金額 = 港元 1_500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  本公司 amend 連同 new_amount = 港元 2_000_000, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> 已提議
  客戶 sign -> 被拒絕 "bo:in-person sign"
  客戶 sign 親身確認 -> signed
  本公司 amend 連同 new_amount = 港元 1, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> 被拒絕 "bo:requires amend 1"
  本公司 countersign -> effective
  本公司 close 時間 2027-06-30 -> closed
  本公司 close -> 被拒絕

測試 "what one party cannot do alone"
  本公司 建立 連同 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金額 = 港元 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  本公司 amend 連同 new_amount = 港元 600_000, new_start = 2027-01-01 -> 經 客戶 同意
  本公司 amend 連同 new_amount = 港元 900_000, new_start = 2027-01-01
  -> 被拒絕 "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  本公司 sign -> 經 客戶 同意
  客戶 countersign -> 被拒絕 "bo:state countersign"
  客戶 sign 由 AI 代理 -> signed
  客戶 countersign -> 經 本公司 同意
  本公司 close -> 被拒絕 "bo:state close"

測試 "too late to sign"
  本公司 建立 連同 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金額 = 港元 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  客戶 sign 時間 2027-01-02 -> 被拒絕 "bo:requires sign 2"

# 双方就条款达成协议。本公司提出条款；客户在开始日期前签署（金额超过港元
# 1,000,000 须本人确认）；本公司加签后条款生效，直至本公司经客户同意终结。
# 修订也须经客户同意，且只限于条款仍为已提议期间。
合约 Agreement
参与方 本公司、客户

记录 Terms
  terms 文本
  金额 港元
  starts 日期

可 amend 由 本公司 附带 new_amount 港元, new_start 日期
  须 已提议
  须 经 客户 同意
  须 new_amount > 港元 0
  如果 new_amount > 金额 * 150%
    拒绝 "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  否则
    金额 = new_amount
  starts = new_start
可 sign 由 客户
  超过 1_000_000 须本人确认
  须 现在 < starts
  已提议 -> signed
可 countersign 由 本公司
  signed -> effective
可 close 由 本公司
  须 经 客户 同意
  effective -> closed

测试 "signed in person, countersigned, and closed"
  本公司 创建 时间 2026-10-14 附带 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金额 = 港元 1_500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  本公司 amend 附带 new_amount = 港元 2_000_000, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> 已提议
  客户 sign -> 被拒绝 "bo:in-person sign"
  客户 sign 本人确认 -> signed
  本公司 amend 附带 new_amount = 港元 1, new_start = 2027-01-08 -> 被拒绝 "bo:requires amend 1"
  本公司 countersign -> effective
  本公司 close 时间 2027-06-30 -> closed
  本公司 close -> 被拒绝

测试 "what one party cannot do alone"
  本公司 创建 附带 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金额 = 港元 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  本公司 amend 附带 new_amount = 港元 600_000, new_start = 2027-01-01 -> 经 客户 同意
  本公司 amend 附带 new_amount = 港元 900_000, new_start = 2027-01-01
  -> 被拒绝 "an amendment may raise the amount by half at most"
  本公司 sign -> 经 客户 同意
  客户 countersign -> 被拒绝 "bo:state countersign"
  客户 sign 由 AI 代理 -> signed
  客户 countersign -> 经 本公司 同意
  本公司 close -> 被拒绝 "bo:state close"

测试 "too late to sign"
  本公司 创建 附带 terms = "100 t of steel, monthly", 金额 = 港元 500_000, starts = 2027-01-01
  客户 sign 时间 2027-01-02 -> 被拒绝 "bo:requires sign 2"

contract Values
parties we, customer

record Sheet
  label text
  approved yes or no
  total HKD
  ends date
  share 10%
  grace 30 days
  cap HKD 1_000

can fill by we with unit_price HKD, units number, note text, ok yes or no, from_day date
  requires units > 0 and ok = yes
  requires note = label or note = "any"
  total = unit_price * units
  requires total / units = unit_price
  ends = from_day + 3 months
  if ends - from_day > 100 days
    reject "too long"
  approved = total * share > cap
  label = note
can adjust by we with part HKD, whole HKD
  requires part / whole < 50%
  total = part + whole - cap
  ends = ends + grace - 1 month
  if today > ends or not approved
    reject "late"

runs.label: create
fill, no units
fill, wrong note
fill, overflow
fill, HKD 12.50 x 3
fill, HKD 5,000 x 3
adjust, two thirds
adjust, by zero
adjust, a third
adjust, too late

# Tests that fail, and how bo test says so: a step that ends in another
# state, a refusal that does not come, a consent nobody asks for, another
# reason; a test stops at its first failing step.
contract Deal
parties we, customer

record Terms
  price HKD

can accept by customer
  requires price > HKD 0
  proposed -> accepted
can withdraw by we
  if price > HKD 1_000
    reject "too large to withdraw"
  proposed -> withdrawn

test "accepted, not withdrawn"
  we create with price = HKD 500
  customer accept -> withdrawn
  we withdraw

test "nothing to refuse"
  we create with price = HKD 500
  we withdraw -> refused "too large to withdraw"

test "a consent nobody asks for"
  we create with price = HKD 5_000
  customer accept -> consent of bank1

test "another reason"
  we create with price = HKD 5_000
  we withdraw -> refused "bo:state withdraw"

test
  we create with price = HKD 5_000
  customer accept

# The spec's ReceivableFinancing example (bo-1.0, section 8), with its tests:
# pledge and transfer are built-in actions, with the standard library's terms.
contract ReceivableFinancing
parties issuer, supplier, bank

asset Receivable
  amount HKD
  due date
  holder supplier

can pledge to bank
  over 5_000_000 requires in person
can transfer
when due issuer pays

test "the supplier pledges the receivable to its bank"
  issuer issue with amount = HKD 3_000_000, due = 2027-06-30
  supplier pledge to bank1 -> pledged
  supplier pledge to bank2 -> refused
  supplier transfer to factor1 -> refused

test "the bank's consent is needed"
  issuer issue with amount = HKD 3_000_000, due = 2027-06-30
  supplier pledge to bank1 -> consent of bank1

test "only the holder pledges"
  issuer issue with amount = HKD 3_000_000, due = 2027-06-30
  bank1 pledge to bank1 -> consent of supplier

test "over HKD 5,000,000 the holder proves presence"
  issuer issue with amount = HKD 8_000_000, due = 2027-06-30
  supplier pledge to bank1 -> refused "bo:in-person pledge"
  supplier pledge to bank1 in person -> pledged

test "the supplier sells the receivable, and the buyer pledges it"
  issuer issue with amount = HKD 3_000_000, due = 2027-06-30
  supplier transfer to supplier -> refused "bo:requires transfer 1"
  supplier transfer to factor1 -> active
  supplier pledge to bank1 -> consent of factor1
  factor1 pledge to bank1 -> pledged

# A receivable with every action of CexChain's native receivables (spec
# section 13), from the standard library: the counterparty of a pledge or a
# transfer is named by each call (R21), as the native `to` is. The steps
# follow the native rules' flow; stdlib_test.cpp runs the same calls on them.
contract Receivable
parties issuer, supplier

asset Receivable
  amount HKD
  due date
  holder supplier

can transfer
can pledge
can release
can enforce
can pay
can confirm payment
can dispute
can freeze
can unfreeze
can cancel

test "pledge, release, transfer, pay, dispute, confirm"
  issuer issue with amount = HKD 1_000_000, due = 2027-06-30
  supplier pledge to bank1 -> pledged
  supplier pledge to bank2 -> refused "bo:state pledge"
  supplier transfer to factor1 -> refused "bo:state transfer"
  bank1 release -> active
  supplier transfer to factor1 -> active
  supplier transfer to factor2 -> consent of factor1
  issuer pay -> paid
  factor1 dispute -> disputed
  issuer pay -> paid
  factor1 confirm payment -> settled
  issuer freeze -> refused

test "paid to the pledgee, under a freeze"
  issuer issue with amount = HKD 1_000_000, due = 2027-06-30
  supplier pledge to bank1 -> pledged
  issuer freeze -> frozen
  bank1 release -> refused "bo:state release"
  issuer pay -> refused "bo:state pay"
  issuer unfreeze -> pledged
  issuer pay -> paid
  supplier confirm payment -> consent of bank1
  bank1 confirm payment -> settled

test "the bank enforces its pledge"
  issuer issue with amount = HKD 1_000_000, due = 2027-06-30
  supplier pledge to bank1 -> pledged
  supplier cancel -> refused "bo:state cancel"
  bank1 enforce -> active
  bank1 pledge to bank2 -> pledged

test "cancelled"
  issuer issue with amount = HKD 1_000_000, due = 2027-06-30
  issuer unfreeze -> refused "bo:state unfreeze"
  supplier cancel -> cancelled
  supplier transfer to factor1 -> refused

# A warehouse receipt with every action of CexChain's native receipts (spec
# section 13): goods redeemed in parts, with the pledgee's consent while
# pledged; redeemed when nothing remains.
contract WarehouseReceipt
parties warehouse, depositor

asset Receipt
  quantity tonne
  holder depositor

can transfer
can pledge
can release
can enforce
can redeem
can freeze
can unfreeze
can cancel

test "goods redeemed in parts"
  warehouse issue with quantity = 30 tonne
  depositor redeem with portion = 0 tonne -> refused "bo:requires redeem 3"
  depositor redeem with portion = 40 tonne -> refused "bo:requires redeem 4"
  depositor redeem with portion = 10 tonne -> active
  depositor pledge to bank1 -> pledged
  depositor redeem with portion = 5 tonne -> pledged
  depositor transfer to trader1 -> refused "bo:state transfer"
  bank1 release -> active
  depositor transfer to trader1 -> active
  trader1 redeem with portion = 15 tonne -> redeemed
  trader1 redeem with portion = 1 tonne -> refused

test "frozen while pledged"
  warehouse issue with quantity = 30 tonne
  depositor pledge to bank1 -> pledged
  warehouse freeze -> frozen
  depositor redeem with portion = 1 tonne -> refused "bo:state redeem"
  warehouse unfreeze -> pledged
  depositor redeem with portion = 30 tonne -> redeemed

# Time rules (bo-1.0, section 6; milestone 12): 3 days overdue, the instance
# is suspended; 30 days suspended, it ends. A keeper calls each rule's
# function, and the ledger's registration time decides: before its time the
# call is refused, and a rule applies once for each time.
contract Hosting
parties we, customer

record Plan
  due date

can settle by customer
  active, suspended -> settled
can extend by we with until date
  requires until > due
  due = until
can reopen by we
  suspended -> active
when overdue 3 days suspend
when suspended 30 days terminate

test "3 days overdue, the instance is suspended"
  we create with due = 2027-06-30 at 2027-06-01
  keeper suspend at 2027-07-02 -> refused "bo:when when.suspend"
  keeper suspend at 2027-07-03 -> suspended
  keeper suspend -> refused "bo:fired when.suspend"

test "a keeper that comes late still suspends, and the event says how late"
  we create with due = 2027-06-30 at 2027-06-01
  keeper suspend at 2027-07-10 -> suspended

test "once for each time: reopened, it stays open until the due date moves"
  we create with due = 2027-06-30 at 2027-06-01
  keeper suspend at 2027-07-03 -> suspended
  we reopen -> active
  keeper suspend at 2027-07-04 -> refused "bo:fired when.suspend"
  we extend with until = 2027-07-31 -> active
  keeper suspend at 2027-08-02 -> refused "bo:when when.suspend"
  keeper suspend at 2027-08-03 -> suspended

test "30 days suspended, it ends"
  we create with due = 2027-06-30 at 2027-06-01
  keeper suspend at 2027-07-03 -> suspended
  keeper terminate at 2027-08-01 -> refused "bo:when when.terminate"
  keeper terminate at 2027-08-02 -> terminated
  customer settle -> refused "bo:state settle"

test "paid in time: nothing to suspend"
  we create with due = 2027-06-30 at 2027-06-01
  customer settle at 2027-06-29 -> settled
  keeper suspend at 2027-07-03 -> refused "bo:state suspend"

# Time rules (milestone 12): each kind of time a rule fires at, conditions on
# time in actions, a written UTC offset, and the keeper's steps.
contract Membership
parties we, customer

record Plan
  due date
  fee HKD
  UTC offset "+09:00"

can prolong by customer with until date
  requires 30 days before due
  requires not overdue 10 days
  due = until
can settle by customer
  requires within 14 days
  active, suspended -> settled
when due customer pays
when 7 days before due and active
  fee = fee + HKD 10
when overdue suspend
when suspended 1 month terminate
when 2027-12-31
  -> closed

# The spec's VAT (bo-1.0, section 7) in a whole contract, with its tests. The
# invoice's lines are amounts in fen (CNY 0.01). The VAT is added, computed
# once per invoice on the lines' sum, and rounded half up (away from zero):
# 6% until the end of 2026, 9% from 2027-01-01 (local midnight, UTC+08:00).
# A bill is made when the invoice is set, at that call's time, and keeps its
# rate (R26, R28); 重开 (reissue) sets new lines, and so makes a new bill.
合约 销售
参与方 本公司, 客户

记录 销售单
  发票 列表 人民币 最多 20

费用 增值税
  税率 6%
  适用 客户所在地 = 中国内地
  另计
  按发票 四舍五入
  从 2027-01-01 起 税率 9%

可 结算 由 客户 附带 付款 人民币
  须 付款 = 发票 总和 + 增值税
  正常 -> 已结清

可 重开 由 本公司 附带 明细 列表 人民币 最多 20
  须 正常
  发票 = 明细

# Lines 100.00 + 10.05 = 11005 fen; 6% of it is 11005 x 60000 / 1000000 =
# 660.3 fen, so 660 (CNY 6.60); the total is 11005 + 660 = 11665 (CNY 116.65).
测试 "6% 至 2026 年底，每张发票舍入一次"
  本公司 创建 附带 发票 = (人民币 100.00, 人民币 10.05), 客户所在地 = "中国内地" 时间 2026-12-31
  客户 结算 附带 付款 = 人民币 116.66 -> 被拒绝 "bo:requires 结算 1"
  客户 结算 附带 付款 = 人民币 116.65 -> 已结清

# Half a fen: 100.00 + 0.25 = 10025 fen; 6% is 601.5 fen, which half up
# makes 602 (away from zero); the total is 10627 (CNY 106.27).
测试 "半分四舍五入"
  本公司 创建 附带 发票 = (人民币 100.00, 人民币 0.25), 客户所在地 = "中国内地" 时间 2026-12-31

  客户 结算 附带 付款 = 人民币 106.27 -> 已结清

# From 2027-01-01: 9% of 11005 fen is 990.45 fen, so 990; the total is 11995.
测试 "2027 年起 9%"
  本公司 创建 附带 发票 = (人民币 100.00, 人民币 10.05), 客户所在地 = "中国内地" 时间 2027-01-01

# Charges of every kind on one bill (milestone 13): a gratuity on each
# line, rounded half even; a levy, a fixed amount once per bill; VAT on the
# price and the gratuity, once per invoice, rounded down; a surcharge on
# the VAT alone; a tourism tax included in the prices, taken out of each line;
# and a green fee with no rate until 1 July 2027, for bills of three lines or
# more. Amounts are in cents; rates in millionths (5% is 50000).
contract Dinner
parties we, customer

record Table
  invoice list HKD at most 10

charge gratuity
  rate 10%
  added
  per line half even

charge levy
  amount HKD 2
  added

tax vat
  rate 5%
  added
  according to price, gratuity
  according to invoice down

charge surcharge
  rate 7%
  added
  according to vat
  per document

tax tourism
  rate 3%
  included

charge green
  from 2027-07-01 on rate 1%
  applies to count of invoice >= 3
  added

can settle by customer with payment HKD
  requires payment = sum of invoice + gratuity + levy + vat + surcharge + green
  active -> settled

# Lines HKD 12.35 and 8.45 (1235 and 845 cents, 2080 in all):
#   gratuity, 10% on each line, half even: 123.5 -> 124 (to the even cent),
#     84.5 -> 84; 208 in all;
#   levy: 200 once;
#   vat, 5% of the price and the gratuity (2080 + 208 = 2288), down:
#     114.4 -> 114;
#   surcharge, 7% of the vat: 7.98 -> 8 (half up, R17);
#   tourism, 3% included, on each line: 1235 x 30000 / 1030000 = 35.97 -> 36,
#     845 x 30000 / 1030000 = 24.61 -> 25 (in the price, not added);
#   green: no rate before 1 July 2027.
# Total: 2080 + 208 + 200 + 114 + 8 = 2610 (HKD 26.10).
test "the worked example"
  we create with invoice = (HKD 12.35, HKD 8.45) at 2027-06-30
  customer settle with payment = HKD 26.10 -> settled

# Three lines from 1 July 2027: the green fee applies, 1% of each line, half
# up: 1235 -> 12.35 -> 12, 845 -> 8.45 -> 8, 1000 -> 10; 30 in all. Gratuity:
# 124 + 84 + 100 = 308; vat: 5% of 3080 + 308 = 169.4 -> 169; surcharge: 7% of
# 169 = 11.83 -> 12. Total: 3080 + 308 + 200 + 169 + 12 + 30 = 3799.
test "the green fee, from 1 July 2027, on three lines or more"
  we create with invoice = (HKD 12.35, HKD 8.45, HKD 10.00) at 2027-07-01
  customer settle with payment = HKD 37.99 -> settled

# Two lines after 1 July 2027: the green fee does not apply (its condition).
test "the green fee needs three lines"
  we create with invoice = (HKD 12.35, HKD 8.45) at 2027-07-01
  customer settle with payment = HKD 26.10 -> settled

# Lists (milestone 13): bounded lists in fields, inputs, and the state;
# each, sum of, count of, and in; one value where a list is needed is a list
# of one item (R29). A batch keeps its codes and sizes; loading adds rows.
contract Batches
parties we, customer

record Batch
  codes list text at most 3
  sizes list number
  total number

can load by we with rows list number at most 4, tags list text
  requires count of rows > 0
  requires sum of rows < 100
  each n in rows
    requires n > 0
    total = total + n
  each t in tags
    if t in ("x", "y")
      reject "no x or y"
  requires not ("bad" in tags)
  sizes = rows

can mark by we with code text
  requires code in codes
  codes = ("a", "b")
  each s in (1, 2, 3)
    requires s < 5

can check by customer with size number
  requires size in sizes
  requires sizes = (1, 2)

test "lists in and out"
  we create with codes = ("p", "q"), sizes = 1, total = 0
  we load with rows = (1, 2), tags = ("a", "b")
  customer check with size = 2
  customer check with size = 3 -> refused "bo:requires check 1"
  we mark with code = "q"
  we mark with code = "q" -> refused "bo:requires mark 1"
  we mark with code = "a"

test "each item is checked"
  we create with codes = ("p"), sizes = (1, 2), total = 0
  we load with rows = (50, 60), tags = "a" -> refused "bo:requires load 2"
  we load with rows = (1, 0), tags = "a" -> refused "bo:requires load 3"
  we load with rows = 1, tags = "x" -> refused "no x or y"
  we load with rows = 1, tags = ("ok", "bad") -> refused "bo:requires load 4"
  we load with rows = (1, 2, 3), tags = "ok"
  customer check with size = 3 -> refused "bo:requires check 2"

# A supply agreement between a core enterprise (we), its supplier, and its
# bank. We propose the terms; they take effect once the supplier and the
# bank have both consented, each on its own ledger; we close the agreement
# once the supplier confirms that the goods were delivered.
contract SupplyAgreement
parties we, supplier, bank

record Terms
  goods text
  pieces number
  price CNY
  deliver_by date
